slides.say: React uses the initial state only once. But your code might still compute it every render.
Here create initial state runs on every render, even though the result is ignored after the first one. Wasteful for big arrays.
Pass the function itself as the third argument, and its input as the second. React calls create initial state with username, once.

slides.text: Init needs no input? Pass null as the second argument.
slides.say: If your initializer needs no information, pass null as the second argument.
